'''Jutrand''' was a [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Hundreds of corporations had their headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|world]].

==History==
The [[City/Legends|city]] covering the surface of Jutrand was razed by [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], but was subsequently rebuilt. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], Jutrand served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Bactranate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was led by the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]].<ref name="TKEG" />

Following the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], family matriarch [[Vilia Calimondra]] ordered her grandchildren including [[Odion]], [[Daiman]], [[Lioko]], and [[Malakite]] to turn on Bactra. During the [[invasion of the Bactranate]], [[Odionate]] forces conquered Jutrand. However, during a family [[bequest]], Odion's brother Daiman was given control of [[Industrial Heuristics]] and its corporate assets; angering Odion. As recompense, Vilia provided Odion two legions of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] warriors.

The Jutrand system was later a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" /><ref name="TCSWE" />
